title: FLA import fidelity wave 2: media payloads, instance/button handlers, filters & color effects
description: Follow-up to 0697, sourced from its honest capability map (see header comment in packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts). The wave-1 importer extracts pages/layers/shapes/symbols/text/frame-scripts but explicitly warns-and-skips: (1) Media N stream payloads — bitmap (and sound) data is referenced but not decoded into library assets; (2) instance onClipEvent handlers and button on() handlers — now representable in our model since 0517/0663 added per-instance scripts, so wire FLA-side extraction into those fields; (3) filters, blend modes, and color effects on instances; (4) morph/shape-tween data. Work against the committed fixtures (packages/core/fixtures/*.fla) plus the ruffle FLA corpus (152/154 parse baseline — do not regress it). Story-sized: pick the highest-value subset per session, keep the capability map comment truthful as items move from 'warned' to 'imported'. Not capstone-gating; this is the FLA-compatibility pillar deepening.
